name: Yamakazi Kusanagi
source: Kusanagi is a lazy ass pervert with a kind heart even if he dreams to have his own harem of girls at his feet. If someone is in trouble he will help that person no mater what even if it's a stranger and especially if it's a close friend or family. He also practiced jujustu (an old type of martial arts) and kendo since five along with his childhood friend Kogara Sachi but stopped when after losing his temper and broken the arm of a bully. Aside from his harem that will never happen, he wants nothing more then to be a NEET/Hikikomori but sadly because of Sachi that always wakes him up and drags him to school he can't. He is smart and witty when it counts and knows how to keep his grounds in a fight be it kendo or fist fight.
